event_session_codes_chronology_check.name: event_session_codes_chronology_check
event_session_codes_chronology_check.value:
("event_session_codes"."revoked_at" is null and "event_session_codes"."valid_until" is null)
        or ("event_session_codes"."revoked_at" is not null and "event_session_codes"."valid_until" = "event_session_codes"."revoked_at" and "event_session_codes"."revoked_at" >= "event_session_codes"."valid_from")

event_session_codes_revocation_check.name: event_session_codes_revocation_check
event_session_codes_revocation_check.value:
("event_session_codes"."revoked_at" is null and "event_session_codes"."valid_until" is null and "event_session_codes"."release_after" is null and "event_session_codes"."revoked_by_operator_id" is null)
        or ("event_session_codes"."revoked_at" is not null and "event_session_codes"."valid_until" is not null and "event_session_codes"."release_after" is not null and "event_session_codes"."release_after" >= "event_session_codes"."revoked_at" + interval '365 days')

events_public_catalog_idx.name: events_public_catalog_idx
events_public_catalog_idx.where: "events"."visibility" = 'public' and "events"."published_at" is not null and "events"."slug" is not null

events_slug_format_check.name: events_slug_format_check
events_slug_format_check.value: "events"."slug" is null or (char_length("events"."slug") between 3 and 80 and "events"."slug" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$')

events_public_requires_slug_and_publishe.name: events_public_requires_slug_and_published_at_check
events_public_requires_slug_and_publishe.value: "events"."visibility" <> 'public' or ("events"."slug" is not null and "events"."published_at" is not null)

events_close_reason_check.name: events_close_reason_check
events_close_reason_check.value:
("events"."closed_at" is null and "events"."close_reason" is null)
        or ("events"."closed_at" is not null and "events"."close_reason" in ('manual', 'scheduled', 'automatic'))

import_jobs_artifact_uploaded_at_idx.name: import_jobs_artifact_uploaded_at_idx
import_jobs_artifact_uploaded_at_idx.where: "import_jobs"."source_artifact_id" is not null and "import_jobs"."artifact_deleted_at" is null

import_jobs_progress_check.name: import_jobs_progress_check
import_jobs_progress_check.value:
"import_jobs"."processed_count" >= 0
        and ("import_jobs"."error_count" is null or "import_jobs"."error_count" >= 0)
        and (
          "import_jobs"."error_count" is not null
          or ("import_jobs"."initiator_kind" = 'legacy' and "import_jobs"."status" = 'failed')
        )
        and "import_jobs"."processed_count" = "import_jobs"."imported_count" + "import_jobs"."skipped_count" + coalesce("import_jobs"."error_count", 0)
        and ("import_jobs"."total_rows" = 0 or "import_jobs"."processed_count" <= "import_jobs"."total_rows")
        and ("import_jobs"."status" <> 'succeeded' or "import_jobs"."total_rows" = "import_jobs"."processed_count")

import_jobs_safe_error_check.name: import_jobs_safe_error_check
import_jobs_safe_error_check.value:
(
          "import_jobs"."status" = 'failed'
          and "import_jobs"."safe_error_code" is not null
          and char_length("import_jobs"."safe_error_code") between 1 and 100
          and "import_jobs"."safe_error_code" = btrim("import_jobs"."safe_error_code")
          and "import_jobs"."safe_error_code" ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_.-]*$'
          and "import_jobs"."safe_error_summary" is not null
          and char_length("import_jobs"."safe_error_summary") between 1 and 500
          and "import_jobs"."safe_error_summary" = btrim("import_jobs"."safe_error_summary")
        ) or (
          "import_jobs"."status" <> 'failed'
          and "import_jobs"."safe_error_code" is null
          and "import_jobs"."safe_error_summary" is null
        )

import_jobs_lifecycle_check.name: import_jobs_lifecycle_check
import_jobs_lifecycle_check.value:
(
          "import_jobs"."status" = 'queued'
          and "import_jobs"."started_at" is null
          and "import_jobs"."finished_at" is null
        ) or (
          "import_jobs"."status" = 'running'
          and "import_jobs"."started_at" is not null
          and "import_jobs"."finished_at" is null
        ) or (
          "import_jobs"."status" in ('succeeded', 'failed')
          and "import_jobs"."started_at" is not null
          and "import_jobs"."finished_at" is not null
        ) or (
          "import_jobs"."status" = 'cancelled'
          and "import_jobs"."finished_at" is not null
        )

import_jobs_initiator_check.name: import_jobs_initiator_check
import_jobs_initiator_check.value:
(
          "import_jobs"."initiator_kind" = 'operator'
          and "import_jobs"."started_by_operator_id" is not null
        ) or (
          "import_jobs"."initiator_kind" in ('system', 'legacy')
          and "import_jobs"."started_by_operator_id" is null
        )

import_jobs_timestamp_order_check.name: import_jobs_timestamp_order_check
import_jobs_timestamp_order_check.value:
("import_jobs"."started_at" is null or "import_jobs"."started_at" >= "import_jobs"."created_at")
        and (
          "import_jobs"."finished_at" is null
          or (
            "import_jobs"."finished_at" >= "import_jobs"."created_at"
            and ("import_jobs"."started_at" is null or "import_jobs"."finished_at" >= "import_jobs"."started_at")
          )
        )
        and "import_jobs"."updated_at" >= "import_jobs"."created_at"
        and ("import_jobs"."started_at" is null or "import_jobs"."updated_at" >= "import_jobs"."started_at")
        and ("import_jobs"."finished_at" is null or "import_jobs"."updated_at" >= "import_jobs"."finished_at")
        and (
          "import_jobs"."cancellation_requested_at" is null
          or "import_jobs"."cancellation_requested_at" >= "import_jobs"."created_at"
        )

import_jobs_artifact_state_check.name: import_jobs_artifact_state_check
import_jobs_artifact_state_check.value:
(
          "import_jobs"."source_artifact_id" is null
          and "import_jobs"."artifact_uploaded_at" is null
          and "import_jobs"."artifact_deleted_at" is null
        ) or (
          "import_jobs"."source_artifact_id" is not null
          and "import_jobs"."artifact_uploaded_at" is not null
          and (
            "import_jobs"."artifact_deleted_at" is null
            or "import_jobs"."artifact_deleted_at" >= "import_jobs"."artifact_uploaded_at"
          )
        )

import_jobs_cancellation_request_check.name: import_jobs_cancellation_request_check
import_jobs_cancellation_request_check.value: "import_jobs"."cancellation_requested_by_operator_id" is null or "import_jobs"."cancellation_requested_at" is not null

import_jobs_worker_claim_check.name: import_jobs_worker_claim_check
import_jobs_worker_claim_check.value:
(
          "import_jobs"."status" = 'queued'
          and "import_jobs"."attempt_count" = 0
          and "import_jobs"."claim_token" is null
          and "import_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is null
          and "import_jobs"."heartbeat_at" is null
        ) or (
          "import_jobs"."status" = 'running'
          and "import_jobs"."attempt_count" between 1 and 3
          and "import_jobs"."claim_token" is not null
          and "import_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null
          and "import_jobs"."heartbeat_at" is not null
        ) or (
          "import_jobs"."status" in ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')
          and "import_jobs"."claim_token" is null
          and "import_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is null
          and "import_jobs"."heartbeat_at" is null
        )

import_jobs_worker_lease_check.name: import_jobs_worker_lease_check
import_jobs_worker_lease_check.value:
("import_jobs"."heartbeat_at" is null or "import_jobs"."heartbeat_at" >= "import_jobs"."started_at")
        and ("import_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is null or "import_jobs"."lease_expires_at" >= "import_jobs"."heartbeat_at")

operator_users_suspension_state_check.name: operator_users_suspension_state_check
operator_users_suspension_state_check.value:
(
        ("operator_users"."suspended_at" is null and "operator_users"."suspension_reason" is null and "operator_users"."suspended_by_operator_id" is null)
        or
        (
          "operator_users"."suspended_at" is not null
          and "operator_users"."suspension_reason" is not null
          and char_length("operator_users"."suspension_reason") between 1 and 500
          and "operator_users"."suspension_reason" = btrim("operator_users"."suspension_reason")
          and "operator_users"."suspended_by_operator_id" is not null
        )
      )
